    Forwarded
    Please be very careful when you come across alternative Vencord versions that promise more features, plugins, etc. They are very likely malware. It's really not worth the risk. Especially avoid the following two mods:
    • Nightcord: Everything about this mod is extremely suspicious. It contained a Tokenlogger in the past.,
    • Lightcord: Even more suspicious than Nightcord. Contained Malware in the past, developer claims he "got hacked". They also steal both Vencord's and Equicord's code without credit or following the licence terms.,
    If you really need more plugins, look at Equicord instead. Safe and made by good people. (But don't forget rule 13 :P)
